about: Hand-made before/after examples, 10 per rule. 'before' is real field text (2026-11-15 read-only extract, or the live page text of 2026-11-16 which renders the same field). 'after' was written by hand: whole sentences removed by plain string surgery, independently of the cleaner; for R5 the hand verdict is delete_entry / keep_entry. expect_skip marks rows the rules must leave untouched and report. Checked by: python3 -I text_defect_rules.py test
